system_note: Claim MR_SNF_01 - Revenue code 0192 (Rehabilitation therapy), billed 15 day(s), DOS range 2026-07-14 to 2026-08-03. Governing reference defines 0192 as the rehabilitation therapy per-diem level and treats non-covered time on a per-day basis (Policy Documents/SNF/Reference Materials/SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide.docx, pos. 8 and pos. 11). The facility's per-diem-level extraction tool returned a null level_determination_statement for every calendar date in the range; the extractor's own note explains that a null statement commonly means the facility met the billed level's minute threshold and therefore had no exception to document (get_per_diem_level_notes result note). The clinical record contains documented therapy sessions with substantial minutes on 15 distinct service dates within the billed range (each listed in the daily_services results). Examples: 2026-07-14 has Physical Therapy 90 minutes and Occupational Therapy 60 minutes; similar PT (90 min) + OT (60 min) sessions are documented repeatedly through 2026-07-31 and on 2026-08-03 (see the daily_services rows cited). Because (1) the payer-agnostic reference identifies 0192 as the rehab per-diem (supports the billed code), (2) the extractor's null-level note indicates absence of an exception (i.e., the facility likely met the billed level) rather than a documented downcoding rationale, and (3) the record documents high therapy-minute sessions on 15 distinct dates that match the billed unit count, the documentation supports the billed 0192 per-diem units as submitted. No adjustment to units, revenue code, or date range is indicated by the retrieved records. Citations to the exact passages used are listed below. Reviewed MR_SNF_01, billed revenue code 0191 for dates 2026-07-14 through 2026-08-03 (5 days on this revenue line within the claim's broader stay). Claim metadata shows billed days = 20 and authorized days = 21 (no exceed-authorized-days issue) (see evidence: claim row). Daily therapy documentation for every date in the billed range shows consistent, skilled therapy services (both Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy) with repeated entries of PT = 90 minutes and OT = 60 minutes on the listed service dates (representative daily-service rows cited below). The payer-specific guideline for "Silverleaf Medicare Advantage" is not available in the dataset and the review therefore uses the payer-agnostic Level of Care reference guide; that guide defines "Skilled need" as "A service that requires the involvement of licensed nursing or therapy staff..." and lists revenue code 0191 as one of the standard SNF per-diem codes (0191 = skilled nursing) (see evidence: reference guide, positions 6 and 8). The facility-level per-diem level determination extractor (get_per_diem_level_notes) returned null for every date (no explicit per-day downcode statements); the tool's note clarifies that a null level_determination_statement commonly indicates the facility recorded no exception because the billed level's criteria were met that day. Taken together: (1) abundant, day-by-day skilled therapy minutes are documented across the entire billed date range; (2) the Level of Care guide's definition of "skilled need" is met by those skilled therapy services; and (3) there is no evidence of non-covered/custodial-only days in the retrieved data. Therefore the clinical record as retrieved supports the billed per-diem level 0191 for the full 2026-07-14 to 2026-08-03 date range. Citations: Claim metadata (billed/authorized days) - get_claim result; Skilled-need and revenue-code definitions - Policy Documents/SNF/Reference Materials/SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide.docx (position 6 and 8); representative daily therapy service entries (2026-07-14 PT/OT, 2026-07-15 PT/OT, 2026-07-31 PT/OT, 2026-08-03 PT) - get_daily_services rows; per-diem level note rows showing null statements for those dates - get_per_diem_level_notes rows.

evidence_cited.excerpt: Non-covered day: A day within an otherwise covered stay where documentation does not support the billed level of care for that specific day; does not require the entire stay to be denied.

level_determination_statement is null on a date when the daily note doesn't state an explicit per-diem-level exception for it - that does NOT by itself mean the day is unsupported; it commonly means the billed level's own minute threshold was met that day, so the facility had no exception to document. A non-null statement is the facility's own basis for downcoding that specific date.
